content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR SaaS: 1. PRD. 2. UI/UX Specs. 3. SaaS & Multi-Tenant Architecture (RLS, schema, DB isolation). 4. Subscription & Billing Logic (proration, dunning). 5. API Contracts. 6. DB Schema & Privacy (GDPR/HIPAA). 7. SaaS Threat Model (cross-tenant leakage). 8. DFDs. 9. SLA Definitions. 10. CI/CD. 11. IaC Templates. 12. App Security. 13. DR & Fallback. 14. Incident Response. 15. Runbooks. 16. Audit Reports. 17. Dependency Analysis. 18. Customer Support Workflow.
